title: Stubbornness is not a spiritual path
summary: Self-will cannot find the One; grace must draw the seeker near. Do not let the search outrun shelter.
takeaway: Do not let the search outrun shelter.
lifeApplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.

source.shortMeaning: Self-will cannot find the One; grace must draw the seeker near.
source.lifeApplication: When striving gets hard, ask to be led rather than to force arrival.

evidence.coreClaim: Self-will cannot find the One; grace must draw the seeker near.
evidence.turn: Remember this: the path becomes visible when service turns fruitful.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before starting one more search, stay with the shelter already in front of you and keep one line there.
